- Publisher: Poly Haven

- Authors: Greg Zaal (photography), Dario Barresi (processing)

Original 2K diffuse, displacement and roughness maps are preserved unchanged in `source/`; download URLs, sizes and publisher MD5 hashes are recorded in `manifest.json`. `.gdignore` excludes this source library from runtime imports. The photographed rock is desaturated and combined with project-authored mineral bands, geometry and roughness in the baked iron assets under `assets/items/ore/iron/`. It is not assigned to copper.
